verdict.rationale: First-party CLI docs explicitly say you can "call codex exec from repeatable workflows and pipelines" and "run a non-interactive command in a repeatable workflow" (codex-docs-32, codex-docs-19). The docs also describe automating repeatable work from the terminal (codex-docs-8) and letting Codex edit files or run commands without asking (codex-docs-17/39), which unattended runs need. missing for 10: detailed codex exec reference (flags, structured/JSON output, exit codes), independent or hands-on corroboration of scripted/CI use.
